2. You must not use the service for any illegal purpose, including but not limited to: generating unlawful content, infringing on others' rights, or spreading malicious information.

3. You must not attempt to bypass access controls, usage limits, or other security mechanisms.

4. You must not reverse-engineer, vulnerability-scan, or conduct any form of attack against the platform.

5. If you suspect unauthorized account activity, contact the administrator immediately.
TermsPage.Section3Body:
To ensure stable service for all users, the platform enforces a monthly usage limit:

• Each account has a monthly token quota (default: 100M tokens)
• When monthly usage exceeds the limit, subsequent requests will be rejected with 429 Too Many Requests
• Daily usage is for reference only and does not have a hard limit

Usage resets at the start of each month. Contact the administrator if you need a higher limit.
